thresholds.supports: T1 at k=6 at or above 0.60 and T2 at or above 0.70
thresholds.does_not_support: T1 below 0.60 or T2 below 0.70; the manuscript then reports the shortfall in the abstract
thresholds.rationale: The array's cross-validated R6 in the manuscript is 0.71, the lowest of the eighteen, and its severe-loss rate 38.5%, the highest. Thresholds are set below the in-sample values because new pairs are unseen, and above the value a random six-condition panel reaches on this array (0.39 in Table 1).
